blocks.text: CEBU, Philippines– SM Supermalls continues to help shape Cebu’s evolving business and lifestyle landscape through destinations that create economic opportunities and deliver maxed-out experiences for Cebuanos and visitors. Through its most-loved SM malls—SM City Cebu, SM J Mall, and SM Seaside City Cebu—SM brings together shopping, dining, entertainment, and leisure while supporting the province’s growing commercial and tourism activity. Complementing this network, SMX Convention Center Seaside Cebu adds a significant new dimension to SM’s presence, supporting Cebu’s ambition to become a premier destination for Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions (MICE) As Cebu continues to attract more tourists, investors, and business travelers, […]...
